about: Voice descriptions are Japanese sentences about how the voice sounds, following the prompt style of Takuya, 'Gemini 3.8 Flash TTSを日本語で58本作って検証', Qiita, 2026-09-24 (https://qiita.com/Takuya__/items/45a3c0b0da5c17f0b3bc) and 河合継, 'Google Gemini TTSカスタム音声 日本語作り方', Crystal Method blog, 2026-09-23 (https://crystal-method.com/blog/google-gemini-flash-tts-custom-voice-japanese/). Both are single-author blog posts; neither measured which wording works best.

designed.name: koenami-f-light
designed.prompt: 高めで明るく、軽い女性の声。張りがあって響きは前に出る感じで、話すテンポは速め。標準語。
